description: Tell the Crook tab GitHub Copilot CLI runs in what it is doing: running when a prompt is sent and around every tool, needs-input with the notification's text whenever it stops to ask, and idle when its turn ends, each naming the session it is from, so a subagent's prompt names no tab and its stop ends no turn. Each command does nothing unless it runs in a Crook pane or inside tmux, with the crook binary reachable ($CROOK_BIN, else crook on PATH); inside tmux, crook writes the report to the terminal of each of tmux's clients, and one that is not Crook drops it unread. Each exits 0 even when the report fails, since Copilot denies the tool call a preToolUse hook failed over. Each is a bash command, for macOS and Linux.

sessionStart.bash: [ "$TERM_PROGRAM" = Crook ] || [ -n "$CROOK_PANE_ID" ] || [ -n "$TMUX" ] || exit 0; crook=$CROOK_BIN; [ -x "$crook" ] || crook=$(command -v crook) || exit 0; "$crook" --agent running --title - --session-start - || exit 0

userPromptSubmitted.bash: [ "$TERM_PROGRAM" = Crook ] || [ -n "$CROOK_PANE_ID" ] || [ -n "$TMUX" ] || exit 0; crook=$CROOK_BIN; [ -x "$crook" ] || crook=$(command -v crook) || exit 0; "$crook" --agent running --title - --session - || exit 0

preToolUse.bash: [ "$TERM_PROGRAM" = Crook ] || [ -n "$CROOK_PANE_ID" ] || [ -n "$TMUX" ] || exit 0; crook=$CROOK_BIN; [ -x "$crook" ] || crook=$(command -v crook) || exit 0; "$crook" --agent running --session - || exit 0

postToolUse.bash: [ "$TERM_PROGRAM" = Crook ] || [ -n "$CROOK_PANE_ID" ] || [ -n "$TMUX" ] || exit 0; crook=$CROOK_BIN; [ -x "$crook" ] || crook=$(command -v crook) || exit 0; "$crook" --agent running --session - || exit 0

notification.bash: [ "$TERM_PROGRAM" = Crook ] || [ -n "$CROOK_PANE_ID" ] || [ -n "$TMUX" ] || exit 0; crook=$CROOK_BIN; [ -x "$crook" ] || crook=$(command -v crook) || exit 0; "$crook" --agent needs-input --message - --session - || exit 0

agentStop.bash: [ "$TERM_PROGRAM" = Crook ] || [ -n "$CROOK_PANE_ID" ] || [ -n "$TMUX" ] || exit 0; crook=$CROOK_BIN; [ -x "$crook" ] || crook=$(command -v crook) || exit 0; "$crook" --agent idle --session - || exit 0

sessionEnd.bash: [ "$TERM_PROGRAM" = Crook ] || [ -n "$CROOK_PANE_ID" ] || [ -n "$TMUX" ] || exit 0; crook=$CROOK_BIN; [ -x "$crook" ] || crook=$(command -v crook) || exit 0; "$crook" --agent idle --session - || exit 0
